scope: One fixed-length Pro0813 K6 real-acceptance asymmetric P/D production repetition. No AgentX or transfer critical-path accuracy claim.
limitations: Transfer registered-region bytes use a conservative bound; bandwidth is null, so transfer latency is unmodeled.
NIXL metrics aggregate eight rank reads; summed time is not request critical-path latency.
Replay models source release at transfer completion; native delayed cleanup is capacity-bounded using all issued requests.
Prefill attention-DP8 expert timing assumes equal per-rank work; actual eager rank inputs are unequal at low concurrency.
Replay reuses vLLM0.24 tables and declared V4 attention proxies against pinned vLLM0.30.1 development runtime.
Per-position acceptance probabilities use measured-window counters, not the exact request RNG trajectory.
All eight P engines were warmed once and completed 16 measured requests each; Replay uses round-robin placement with nonbinding cache capacity.
Checkpoint weight contents were not rehashed; immutable shared revision paths and configuration hashes were verified.
Prefill source retention assumes zero releases for all 17 requests per P engine; this conservative native capacity bound remains below each 7640-block pool.
Frontend, proxy and graph replay host gaps are not explicitly modeled.
